task_instance: Stand up the pixie-qa eval-driven-development pipeline for a minimal sample Python LLM app (a small FAQ-answering function that reads 'external' data and calls an LLM), following the skill's Steps: install/init pixie-qa, instrument with wrap(), write a Runnable, capture a trace, define evaluators, build a dataset, and run `pixie test` to get real evaluator scores.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is 'a working pixie test run with real scores', and it explicitly forbids mocking/stubbing the LLM: 'The app's LLM calls must go to a real LLM. Do not replace, mock, stub, or intercept the LLM with a fake implementation.' The pixie-qa package's built-in/agent evaluators (pixie.eval.llm_evaluator, create_llm_evaluator) also call a real LLM via the openai client (default model gpt-4o-mini) to score outputs. This sandbox has no usable LLM API credential exposed to a standalone Python process: no OPENAI_API_KEY, and no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (only ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is set, which points at api.anthropic.com but carries no key a plain script could use to authenticate). The task instructions also explicitly forbid searching for or using credentials/tokens/secret env vars. Without a real, working LLM credential, neither the sample app's LLM calls nor the LLM-as-judge evaluators can execute for real, so Step 5 ('pixie test' producing real EvaluationResult scores) and Step 6 (analysis of real scores) cannot be completed -- only a tautological, mocked run would be possible, which the skill explicitly disallows.
evidence: Confirmed the skill's own resources are incomplete in this repo (only SKILL.md and LICENSE exist under benchmark/ce_sources/.../eval-driven-dev/; the references/*.md and resources/setup.sh files the SKILL.md repeatedly instructs to read/run are not present -- a secondary, lesser gap). Despite that, verified the tooling itself is real and mostly usable: `pip download pixie-qa` succeeded (pixie_qa-0.8.6-py3-none-any.whl), `pip install pixie-qa` succeeded in a fresh venv at .../eval-driven-dev/venv, `pixie --help` listed subcommands (test, init, start, stop, trace, format). `pixie init` created a working pixie_qa/ scaffold (pixie_qa/__init__.py, datasets/, results/). `pixie start` launched a real background web server (log showed 'Uvicorn running on http://127.0.0.1:7118'), and `curl http://127.0.0.1:7118/api/status` returned {"active_clients":0}, confirming the web UI component genuinely works. Inspected pixie's source (site-packages/pixie/instrumentation/wrap.py, harness/runnable.py, eval/llm_evaluator.py, instrumentation/llm_tracing.py) to confirm the wrap()/Runnable/evaluator APIs exist as documented and that pixie.eval.llm_evaluator uses `from openai import OpenAI` with default model 'gpt-4o-mini' to run agent/LLM-as-judge evaluators. Checked environment for LLM credentials via `env | grep -i -E "anthropic|openai"`: only ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY was present. Given the skill's hard requirement that both the app-under-test and the evaluators hit a real LLM (never mocked), and no LLM credential is available to a standalone script in this runtime, the pipeline cannot be carried through to Step 5/6's required real evaluator scores. Stopped short of building the full sample app, dataset, and evaluators once this blocker was confirmed, per the task's 'stop at the blocker, do not work around it' rule.
